identity.title: Park Ailuros feature growth until a verified buyer and integration workflow appears

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Enterprise AI governance may be valuable but the owner explicitly lacks confidence in integration/market fit. Do not resume generic feature development until observed team pain and adoption path exist.
human_pressure.goal: Identify one real buying problem through existing EverRun external trials or integration partner interviews
non_goals: New dashboard platform, broad compliance claims or feature expansion
Force EverRun to depend on Ailuros
red_lines: Do not claim measurable compliance risk reduction or budget until validated

steps.description: Interview a product owner/security lead/team lead about an actual agent incident, existing governance tools, their workflow and purchasing authority.
Map 1–2 concrete observability or audit needs against already-existing Ailuros components; explicitly measure integration steps and manual setup.
Prefer a single read-only, opt-in evaluation with EverRun or another real agent source; gather value, alternative, deployment costs and no-go criteria.
Only if customer value appears, create separate scoped integration packs; otherwise keep project paused.

acceptance: A dated integration demo or an explicit STOP/UNKNOWN verdict with reasons
Clear buyer, budget owner, ROI hypothesis and measured integration cost, or an explicit missing-evidence note
No immediate code work generated by this backlog

promotion_gate: No coding or product change before real external integration and purchaser evidence.
